<context_for_action>
The timeout occurred because `build-essential` pulls in 119 packages (including g++, docs, and many dependencies). For compiling SQLite with gcov, you only need gcc, make, and libc6-dev - a much smaller set that should install in seconds rather than timing out. Try `apt-get install -y gcc make libc6-dev` instead of build-essential.
</context_for_action>
